summary: Logs, traces, and filtered evidence become the only way to explain failures once the system is under load.
youtube_description:
Logs, traces, and filtered evidence become the only way to explain failures once the system is under load. The lecture focuses on log aggregation, pressure-based filtering, and operational evidence that preserves the invariant.

This CS 5254 Week 12 lecture explores observability under stress and its impact on concurrent system design.
